notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
I fixed some bugs that I should have taken care of long ago. Scenarios are now fully playable along with minor bug fixes.

Language support has been dropped as I think most of the people who did the translations just use google translate. I got scammed.

Also I changed the speech laws thing in the game. I'm not really comfortable with the way it was before. The policies have been replaced with something different. The pandemic has given me a lot to think about and my philosophy continues to develop about everything.

I hope you enjoyed my game. It was a lot of work. Give me a link for doing an update this many years into it. 

I have made a much better City Builder called Epic City Builder 4. I spent 3 years on that game and it is the biggest project I've ever done. 

Thank you all.

notes.title: What do you want in the next game?
notes.content:
What do you want in my next city builder?

The next one is going to be 3d and a lot like Megacity Builder.

notes.title: Epic City Builder 4
notes.content:
I'm making a new 3d city builder. It will have all the features of Megacity Builder only more. It will also take advantage of modern hardware.

I've been making city builders now for almost 10 years. I never take any features out only add to them. This game is going to be huge. 

The game is in the early stages right now. I'm modeling the buildings one by one. That is going to take a while. Writing the code will go faster.  

What are you looking forward to in my 5'th city builder?

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
New update. The game is basically bug free now. 

Only a rare Z order bug and a rare terrian editing bug are left. They do not effect game play in any way.

These bugs are also very hard to fix.

The Z order bug can not be fixed with code alone.

I'd have to redo all of the game assets.

But this is basically a bug free game now as far as I am aware.

If you find any bugs tell me.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
I've rewritten the draw engine. This should make the frame rate more stable. It also opens up the possibility of much larger maps in future updates. Not that the maps are not already huge.

Also I've made interface improvements based on feedback.

The game should be more enjoyable now.

Be sure to leave a review of the game. That means a whole lot.

If you want to chat I have contact info inside the game on the title screen.

Thank you and have a great day.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
Fixed the interface problems people where having.

I like it the old way but seems I'm alone in this.

Simple fix for a simple problem.

Enjoy.
